_comment: PINNED quarantine set — the e2e gate (scripts/run-suites.mjs) FAILS if the live QUARANTINE map drifts from this list, so a suite can never leave the gate silently (see Phase 21b item 1: verify-week entered while adminpay left, count stayed 4, nobody noticed).
